result.search_summary: The request defines a max-bandwidth simple path but leaves the source, destination, and whether the path must be simple or can be any walk unresolved.

gaps.description: The source and destination nodes for the communication link are not specified.
gaps.direct_question: Which node is the source and which node is the destination for the communication link?
gaps.why_material: Different source-destination pairs change the feasible paths and the optimal bandwidth.

gaps.description: It is unclear whether the link must be a simple path with no repeated nodes or may be any walk that only avoids cycles.
gaps.direct_question: Must the communication link be a simple path with no repeated nodes, or is any loop-free walk allowed?
gaps.why_material: Allowing repeated nodes without cycles can change the feasible set and the maximum achievable bandwidth.
